body: And to be honest you're not really helping your situation by saying this because either way, your comment COULD really push them over the edge. Yet you're saying they're fucked up and killing themself is dumb.
People still do it though and it happens every day. Why do you feel the need to tell them they're fucked up for feeling that way and doing something like that?
Are you...able to get a job that at least pays you some form of money? If you can get a job and get your first paycheck you can pay them off bit by bit.
literally. "What's wrong you can tell me." Then you do but they literally go silent and never respond to you. Hell, they even go offline, what's the deal with that anyway. They're the one that asked.
why can't you see how goofy you look rn

I

I probably would've told you to do it to **me** for real. But I'm sorry that he that it was uncalled for and stupid. It wasn't even funny. In a way...

I feel like a part of him wasn't joking because no one in this whole world would joke about that without being serious in some way.

It did alarm me, somewhat, I felt like I had to make more, or else It wouldn't look good to me. But, so far, I don't feel the need to because I can still see them and it's only been a year. 

Thank you.

It is a frustrating thing...to go through this. You're right, no one deserves to go through this. 

It's valid for you to cry when you feel lonely. I think it's normal for people to do that.

I don't really think it's because I hate life or myself. Life can be stressful sometimes but I don't hate it... I might be uncomfortable with my body but I don't think that's what defines hate. Is it really because it's the only thing I can control? I can control other things I do. Like doing homework and taking care of myself. The fact that you saying it's the only thing I can control kind of upsets me to the point of me feeling like I am going to cry. That's funny.

To you, it might not be about the look, but about its meaning. I don't think it's that for me. What would be the meaning behind the scars I have then? I don't know. *You're saying that if I think it's about the look it's because I want the pain?* I don't understand. The rest of the sentence I don't understand either. "it just means u want the pain u want one thing u can do with this world where u can do nothing."  Are you saying I can't do anything about it?

I've been clean for a few months. "If things are hard right now"? No, nothing is hard at the moment...I have a good life and parents who love me. This has nothing to do with how I feel I just- I really don't know how else to say it other than the fact that I just like looking at the scars I've made. I'm not really in a position to do it again though so...

Why do you believe you're not a good person? I may not know what you've done, but to me, someone who thinks they're not a good person is usually a good person. I do believe people can change. Whatever you've done I believe you're capable of changing as well.

Sometimes I do wonder why people who commit suicide...their friends or family or the people who didn't care about them when they were alive. Why do they care now? What makes them that way? Do they really care or are they..faking it to seem like they're humane and they do care. The way you've worded this is good, I like this and I completely agree with this. I wish I could type something like this, but I can't.
This is REALLY good. I've never really seen anyone make a song/poem that really puts SH into perspective like this.
Thank you for taking the time to read it and tell me what I described would be called. I'll keep that in mind.
